text:
sam: quick async standup — GPU fleet capacity / provisioning check

sam: what I did: rotated warm pools in eu-west and ams1, kicked a small drain test on a XLA node. noticed ams1 quota at ~92% on rtx pools.
sam: blockers: cloud quota bump still pending (ticket 4287), autoscaler was sluggish during the drain test (pods stuck Pending ~2m).
sam: today: follow up on quota, land autoscaler fix PR, and run one more short drain in staging.

priya: ack — saw the 2m delay in metrics. looks like kube-proxy churn + node-label mismatch caused pod scheduling to wait.

adeel: repro attempt: local cluster showed kubelet reconnect flaps after drain, pushed a small liveness tweak to the autoscaler. trying a canary deploy now.
adeel: FYI I hit a quota API 429 once when creating preemptible instances — might need backoff in the provisioning loop.

mae: blocker for me: customer canary needs dedicated lane in eu-west, but we don't have spare capacity until quota bump. I can also compact some small jobs but will impact dev experiments.

sam: @mae can you add the dev experiments list to the ticket so we can prioritize?

priya: filed a short dashboard: /dash/gpu/headroom?range=1h — added an annotation at the drain time. link: https://redwood-dash.example.com/d/abc123/gpu-headroom

adeel: can someone run this quick drain command in staging if ops-bot approves?

sam: go for it, staging only.

mae: running now — output: 
```
$ kubectl drain gpu-staging-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
node/gpu-staging-12 cordoned
evicting pod x-rl-worker-3
...
```

priya: looks clean on the dashboard, no long Pending spikes.

ops-bot: autoscaler-canary deployed by adeel (rev 5), health checks passing. :white_check_mark:

sam: next steps: 1) push autoscaler backoff PR to main, 2) follow quota ticket with infra-eng, 3) schedule a short warmup job in eu-west once bump lands.

mae: I'll add the warmup job and small experiment reassigns to the ticket.

adeel: pinging cloud team now — will escalate if no reply in 2 hours.

sam: thanks team. short and sweet today, ping me if you see anything odd in the next 2h. :coffee:
